title: EchoNoteAnnotationTemplate
description: Standard schema and annotation guidelines for spoken-thought journal evaluation.

id.description: Unique identifier for the journal entry (e.g. note-001)

dataset_type.description: Must strictly distinguish human-annotated research data from synthetic edge-case fixtures

transcript.description: Full verbatim transcript of the spoken voice thought

reference_summary.description: Concise human-authored reference summary capturing main insights (2-4 sentences)

reference_topics.description: Gold topical keywords/tags identifying core subjects

reference_mood.description: Dominant emotional or cognitive state (e.g. focused, energized, reflective, anxious, calm)

reference_action_items.description: Concrete commitments or next steps explicitly stated by the speaker

key_facts.description: Atomic factual propositions that must be preserved in a faithful summary
